mods.name: cost-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with the session cost so far and what the last turn cost.

mods.name: latte-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt that counts the session cost in lattes. Set the latte price in the plugin options.

mods.name: context-meter
mods.description: A band above the prompt with a 10 cell bar of the context window used, yellow from 60 percent, red from 80.

mods.name: daily-spend
mods.description: A band above the prompt with today's total cost across all your sessions.

mods.name: pomodoro
mods.description: A band above the prompt with a 25/5 focus timer (focus 18:42, break 03:10). Start and stop it with /pomodoro; a toast marks each switch.

mods.name: mood-ring
mods.description: A band above the prompt with a colored dot and a word for the error and block rate of your last 20 tool calls: calm (green) under 10 percent, tense (yellow) under 30, stormy (red) from 30.

mods.name: band-pack
mods.description: Every Baselane band meter in one row above the prompt: session cost, lattes, context bar, today's spend, the focus timer and the mood ring.
